anna_csm: Hey team :wave: NovusHealth is asking for a compact bundle of security evidence for their vendor review — they want SOC2 artifacts, KMS key list, and a network diagram. Need to confirm what's ready and what we need to generate.

devon_security: Quick Q — do they want SOC2 Type II artifacts or the SOC2 bridge letters? Usually they ask for the most recent Type II and the control mappings.

anna_csm: They asked for ISO/SOC equivalence, but explicitly mentioned SOC2 reports and a DPA appendix. Let's assume Type II first, then bridge letter if requested.

sam_infra: I can export the network diagram and VPC flow sketch. Will need the customer-facing sanitized version (no internal IPs). ETA 2 business days. I can drop to `s3://redwood-evidence/novushealth/` when ready.

jess_ops: Also confirm retention / logs: Novus specifically called out embedding retention and KMS rotation cadence. We should include our embeddings retention policy excerpt and key rotation schedule.

devon_security: For KMS: we can provide a CSV of active CMKs and whether they're customer-managed or Redwood-managed, plus rotation policy (90 days for keys we manage). We should redact key IDs and provide friendly names only.

anna_csm: Perfect. Sam — can you include the control owner for the network diagram artifact? Dev — can you prepare the control mapping doc (which SOC2 control maps to our features) and a short one-page summary? Novus prefers short docs.

sam_infra: Yep — I'll add a 1-pager legend with control owners. Will upload diagram + legend to the S3 path and paste link here.

devon_security: I'll draft the control mapping and a short SOC2 summary. Also will attach the DPA appendix template we've used before. Might need legal to sign off; tagging audit-bot to create a review ticket.

audit-bot: Created ticket #SEC-2145 for legal review and artifact approval. Assignee: devon_security. Due: 2024-05-10.

jess_ops: Heads up — for embeddings retention, we reference `docs/retention/embeddings.md` and the retention table (30/90/365 presets). I'll copy the relevant excerpt to a separate PDF for them.

anna_csm: Nice. Plan: Sam uploads diagram by EOD Thu (2 days). Devon will draft mapping by Fri. I'll coordinate a short call with Novus next Mon to walk through. If legal needs anything, ping here and I'll handle the CS comms. :thumbsup:

devon_security: One more — do we provide HSM/KMS vendor details (e.g., AWS KMS + HSM provider) or just our integration statement? Novus is finserv so they might ask.

sam_infra: We can include vendor names and region info, but not internal account identifiers. I'll add `AWS KMS (us-west-2)` to the diagram metadata.

anna_csm: Great. I'll update the customer timeline and flag renewal risk if this isn't done before next week's check-in. Thanks all — will post the link when uploads are live.

audit-bot: Note: please attach final artifacts to ticket #SEC-2145 for audit trail.
__notes: This thread simulates a short customer-success coordination conversation about SOC2/DPA evidence collection. Messages are in chronological order and formatted as a single continuous string.
